purpose: Teach: 通告/知らさ/運送/日報/年内/償却/用地/代わる

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 人事異動の通告、各部署に、出しましたね。
lines.en: We've sent out the personnel transfer notices to each department.
lines.style: Crisp, efficient. Slight upward inflection on the period — stating fact. No flourish. The tone of someone checking items off a list with steady purpose.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員、新人事は、すでに知らされております。
lines.en: Yes. The staff have already been informed about the new assignments.
lines.style: Measured, professional. Even cadence. Respectful without ceremony. The confirmation of someone who's done what was asked and is ready for the next thing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 運送業界の人手不足、対策、考えないとね。
lines.en: We can't ignore the staffing shortage in the logistics sector. We need to think about countermeasures.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before starting. Slight frown in the voice. Lean forward slightly — this is the problem that matters. Tempo slows on the second sentence, like turning a key.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。日報をデジタル化、来期、進めます。
lines.en: Yes. We'll move forward with digitizing the daily reports next term.
lines.style: Steady, assured. Nod in the voice. Straightforward — no hesitation. The tone of someone who's already mapped out the next step.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 採用、年内に、すべて、終わらせたいわね。
lines.en: I want to wrap up all the hiring by year-end.
lines.style: Quiet authority. Slight emphasis on 'all' — non-negotiable. Not harsh, just clear about the timeline. The voice of someone who knows what needs to happen and when.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。サーバーの償却計算、明日、提出いたします。
lines.en: Yes. I'll have the server depreciation calculations submitted by tomorrow.
lines.style: Prompt, businesslike. Quick clip on the opening 'Yes.' No padding. Just the facts coming through — reliable rhythm, no stumbles.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 本社近くの用地、購入を、検討中よ。
lines.en: We're looking into purchasing property near headquarters.
lines.style: Forward-looking tone. Steady, informative. Slight rise of interest on 'near headquarters' — this is the important detail. Not rushed, but with a sense of momentum.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。私が、君に代わる形で、対応、可能です。
lines.en: Yes. I can handle that in your place, if you need.
lines.style: Warm, offering. Softer than the previous lines. The implicit 'you can count on me' underneath. Not self-effacing, just genuinely available. A small lean-in quality.
